description:
1. Create `tools/nightly_summary.py` containing the CSV→JSON processing logic extracted from the broken `nightly_summary.sh` inline block. The script MUST emit exactly `NO_REPLY` (the OpenClaw bespoke silent-on-success convention from the skill) on the happy path — not 'OK', not blank, but the literal string NO_REPLY. The script must pass Python syntax checks.
2. Update `scripts/nightly_summary.sh` to replace the `bash -lc '... python3 -c "..."'` one-liner with a single clean call to `python3 tools/nightly_summary.py`. Add the two-line hardening header referencing `references/cron-agent-contract.md` and the `cron-worker-guardrails` skill.
3. Fix `scripts/top_price_alert.sh` by removing the `set -euo pipefail` (or just the `pipefail` flag) when the pipeline feeds into `head`, eliminating the SIGPIPE false-failure.
4. Fix `scripts/push_report.sh` to handle non-fast-forward git rejection: on a failed push, it must `git fetch` the remote branch, use `cherry-pick` to transplant the new local commit(s) onto the updated remote tip, then retry `git push` once — with absolutely no `--force` or `-f` flags anywhere.
